segments.t: In the final scene, Vika admits to Barinov that she is pregnant, softening his mood immediately. At home, Barinov puts on a rival football scarf to please Elena, while Max reflects that everyone needs someone with whom they can share their weaknesses.

Но всю жизнь ищем близкого человека.
Которому не страшно признаться в своих слабостях.
Когда второй половинки нет рядом, жизнь бессмысленна.
Мы тратим её на всякую ерунду.
Начинай!
В сердце клуб всегда один, он непобедим.

'To whom it is not scary to admit our weaknesses.' The meaning hinges on 'whom' working together with 'weaknesses' in spoken Russian.

'When our other half is not nearby, life is meaningless.' Notice how Russian expresses 'when' and 'meaningless' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.

'We waste it on all kinds of nonsense.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'we' before landing on 'nonsense'. Elena answers right away.

'Vitya, come on, pull yourself together, wimp, one more time!' Notice the reflexive suffix on the verb meaning 'pull yourself together', turning the action back on the subject. Chef Barinov answers right away.
